answers.core: Downgrading the level of customization that was available before is not great, especially one that a lot of games will want to still have.
answers.workaround:
To workaround the rounded corners, one would need to `Node.get_popup().transparent_bg = true` via script for every popup, which would be incredible cumbersome.

I don't see how to workaround the cutout shadows, however.
